pricing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about pricing

faq.q1: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a1: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes are prorated and reflected in your next billing cycle.
faq.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: For EU customers (including Cyprus), we accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) via Stripe, in EUR. SEPA Direct Debit is available on annual plans.
faq.q3: What happens to unused AI credits?
faq.a3: AI credits reset monthly on your billing date. Professional includes 500 credits/month; Enterprise is unlimited.
faq.a4: You can cancel any time. Your account stays active until the end of the current billing period, then moves to the free plan.
faq.q5: Do you offer discounts for annual billing?
faq.a5: Yes - contact sales for annual billing with up to 20% savings.

drop.title: Drop any document here
drop.body: Electricity and water bills, bank statements, fuel or waste invoices, or a spreadsheet of usage. We check what each one is, show you the figures and the line they came from, and add nothing until you say so.
drop.types: PDF, photo (PNG, JPG, WebP), CSV or Excel. Up to 10 MB each, 10 at a time.

intake.tooMany: You can add up to {max} files at a time. The rest were left out.
intake.readingBody: Working out what this document is and what it says. This can take up to a minute.

reject.unsupported: This file type can't be read. Use a PDF, a photo, a CSV or an Excel file.
reject.scanned_pdf: This PDF is a scanned picture with no text in it, and the reader for scanned files isn't switched on yet. Take a photo of the page and upload that instead.
reject.not_relevant: This doesn't look like something that feeds your footprint. We accept energy, water, fuel and waste bills or invoices, bank statements and usage spreadsheets.
reject.no_figures: We recognised the document but couldn't find a quantity with dates on it, like kWh, m³, kg or km. Money amounts alone aren't enough.
reject.fuel_only: This fuel receipt shows litres, but your footprint records car travel in kilometres. Enter the distance driven in the form below instead.
reject.unreadable: We couldn't read the figures clearly enough to trust them, so nothing was taken from it. A sharper scan or the original PDF usually works.
reject.sheet_no_dates: The spreadsheet has usage columns but no date or month column, so we can't tell which month each figure belongs to. Add a date or month column and upload it again.
reject.bank_image: Bank statements need to be the PDF or CSV export from your bank, not a photo, so every payment can be checked.
reject.reader_off: The document reader isn't set up on this site yet. You can still type figures in below.

warnings.already_uploaded: This bill is already on file. Its figures start unticked so nothing is counted twice.
warnings.period_not_ended: Part of the billing period falls in a month that hasn't ended yet. That part is left out for now.
warnings.unverified_quote: Some figures couldn't be matched word for word in the document. They start unticked. Check them against the document before you add them.
warnings.unit_dropped: Some figures were in a unit we can't use for that line, so they were left out.
warnings.fuel_litres: Fuel litres were found but aren't added, because car travel is recorded in kilometres.
warnings.spend_not_usage: A bank statement shows money spent, not energy or water used, so it doesn't change your footprint figures. It's kept as evidence: these payments are matched to the bills you upload, and the payees help fill your suppliers list.

home.title: Vuneli - Sustainability consultant for Cyprus SMEs
home.description: Vuneli reads your bills and payments, tracks the EU and Cyprus rules that apply to you, and prepares reports and funding matches for your approval.

pricing.title: Pricing - Vuneli Sustainability Plans (EUR, incl. Cyprus VAT)
pricing.description: Simple, transparent pricing in EUR for SMEs in Cyprus and the EU. Includes 19% Cyprus VAT. Choose Free, Pro, or Enterprise.

landing.whySubtitle: Most of the work is reading, chasing and filling in forms. We do that part for you.
landing.powerSubtitle: When a bank, buyer or the law asks about your footprint, the answer is already waiting.
landing.beyondSubtitle: Your team can learn the basics, fund real climate projects and see how you compare with others.
landing.howSubtitle: You can be up and running in an afternoon.
landing.trustedSubtitle: Join hundreds of businesses leading the sustainability revolution
landing.ecoLearningDesc: Lessons built around your own company, so your staff learn what actually matters for your business instead of generic theory.
landing.ecoMarketplaceDesc: Once you've cut what you can, you can support checked climate projects for the rest and follow what your money did.
landing.ecoStudioDesc: Turn your own figures into clean charts and images for reports, posts and presentations. No designer needed.
landing.ecoLeaderboardDesc: See how your business compares with similar companies, and get credit when you improve.
landing.footerTagline: AI-powered sustainability for the modern enterprise
landing.benefitAiTitle: It reads the paperwork for you
landing.benefitAiDesc: Send us an electricity or water bill and Vuneli pulls out the numbers that matter. Nobody has to type them in by hand.
landing.benefitReportTitle: Reports you'd be happy to send
landing.benefitReportDesc: Vuneli drafts sustainability reports in the formats banks and buyers ask for. You read them, fix anything, and approve.
landing.benefitMonitorDesc: New bills, supplier changes and upcoming deadlines are picked up as they happen, so you're not caught out at year end.
landing.benefitLcaDesc: Find out what a single product costs the environment, from the raw materials to the day it's thrown away.
landing.powerEnergyDesc: Your electricity bills show where energy, and money, goes. Vuneli points out what's worth fixing first.
landing.powerBenchmarkDesc: Find out whether your emissions are high or low for a business like yours in Cyprus.
landing.powerComplianceTitle: Only the rules that apply to you
landing.powerComplianceDesc: EU rules change often. Vuneli works out which ones affect your business and when, and ignores the rest.
landing.powerIntegrationsTitle: Works with what you already use
landing.powerIntegrationsDesc: Connect your bank or accounting software, or simply forward your bills by email. Vuneli fits around how you already work.
landing.stepConnectDesc: Upload a bill, forward one by email or connect your bank. Even one electricity bill is enough to start.
landing.stepAnalyzeDesc: It works out your footprint, checks which deadlines apply to you, and makes a note of anything that's missing.
landing.stepActionDesc: Read what Vuneli prepared, change what you like, and approve. Then download it or send it on.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Start with a single bill and Vuneli builds up the picture from there.
landing.visionBody: We're building a sustainability consultant that never clocks off: one that reads your bills, keeps track of deadlines, checks suppliers and finds funding for you. A person still approves every step.
landing.road1Title: One shared record of your company
landing.road1Body: Bills come in by upload or email, alongside your bank and supplier details. Every number is backed by official EU figures.
landing.road2Title: Connected to more of your tools
landing.road2Body: Live bank and accounting feeds, scanned bills, CBAM Registry files, and comparisons with other businesses in your sector in Cyprus.
landing.road3Title: Kept up to date on its own
landing.road3Body: Supplier details, deadlines and funding stay current without you lifting a finger. When a task needs a licensed expert, we bring one in.
landing.whyLocalTitle: Made in Cyprus, ready for Europe
landing.whyLocalDesc: Vuneli starts with what Cypriot businesses deal with every day: EAC and water bills, the island's power grid and its own deadlines. It follows the EU rules too, like VSME, CBAM and EUDR, so the same work holds up when a buyer or bank elsewhere in Europe asks. And it works in Greek just as well as in English.

vision.heroTitleB: a sustainability consultant that never clocks off
vision.heroSubtitle: Vuneli reads your bills, bank payments, suppliers and the public registers. It tracks the deadlines that apply to you, finds what is missing, asks for it, and prepares the work in Greek and English. A person approves every step.
vision.positionSubtitle: Three facts set the shape of this product. Each one is a Cyprus fact, not a European average.
vision.pos1Title: The questions arrive before the law does.
vision.pos1Desc: Most Cypriot SMEs are not in CSRD scope. They still get sustainability questions from EU buyers, from banks pricing green loans, and from customs under CBAM. Each request asks for the same facts in a different form.
vision.pos2Title: Global tools give the wrong number here.
vision.pos2Desc: Cyprus runs an isolated, oil-heavy grid with one of the highest carbon intensities in the EU. A platform that assumes an EU average factor produces a Scope 2 figure an auditor can reject.
vision.pos3Title: The island is made of small companies.
vision.pos3Desc: Enterprise ESG suites start above the budget of a 40 person hotel group or a Limassol ship manager. Those companies do not need another dashboard. They need the work done, in their language.
vision.horizonSubtitle: Four releases, from this quarter to the third quarter of 2027. These are plans, not promises. We move a line to Live only when it works end to end.
vision.q1Title: Q4 2026. Bank and accounting connections go live
vision.q1Desc: Bank of Cyprus and other EU banks through open banking, plus QuickBooks, Xero and other accounting tools. Payments become footprint lines and are matched to the bills you send us.
vision.q2Title: Q1 2027. CBAM Registry files and scanned bills
vision.q2Desc: CBAM reports exported in the official EU Registry format, built from the official default values we already use. Photographed and scanned bills read as well as digital ones.
vision.q3Title: Q2 2027. Peer comparison for Cyprus sectors
vision.q3Desc: Once a business has twelve months of data, Vuneli compares it with similar companies, using public sector data and anonymous customer figures.
vision.q4Title: Q3 2027. Government sign-in and expert hand-off
vision.q4Desc: Sign-in with CY Login for public services, and a hand-off to vetted Cypriot experts when a task needs a person with a licence.
vision.horizon3YrDesc: When a Cypriot business gets a sustainability question, from a bank, a buyer or a regulator, Vuneli already has the answer prepared. Every supplier request pulls one more Cypriot company onto the same shared record.
vision.fusionsSubtitle: Five jobs that run today. Each one replaces a task that a person repeats every month, and each one stops for your approval before anything leaves the building.
vision.fusion1Desc: Ask in plain words. Verde reads your company record, bills, deadlines and suppliers, shows its sources, and drafts the document. It lists what is missing instead of guessing.
vision.fusion1Meta: Drafts are saved to Deliverables after you approve.
vision.fusion2Desc: A fixed rulebook of EU and Cyprus duties is matched to your business. When EUR-Lex amends a law, the rule is marked under review until a person confirms it.
vision.fusion2Meta: No AI ever changes a legal date.
vision.fusion3Desc: It reads each funding call and its official documents, checks the rules against your company, and shows only the calls you can win, or the ones that are one answer away.
vision.fusion3Meta: Every rule is quoted word for word from the source.
vision.fusion4Desc: One supplier list, built from your contacts, CBAM records and bank payees. Each supplier is screened against the official EU sanctions list and checked on WikiRate.
vision.fusion4Meta: Possible matches go to a person, never auto-blocked.
vision.fusion5Desc: Forward your EAC and water bills to your own Vuneli address. They are read, turned into footprint figures, and matched to the bank payment.
vision.fusion5Meta: Bills that cannot be read are flagged, not guessed.
vision.matrixSubtitle: The full build register. We publish it because a roadmap without dates is marketing.
vision.matrixEmpty: No capability matches that filter. Clear the search to see the full register.
vision.waitlistSubtitle: Create a workspace, add your company details or just tell Verde about your business, and start with one bill.
